This DreamApply listing (ID 8503534) is part of the Study in Estonia application system, where international students apply directly to Estonian university programmes. Many Estonian programmes offer tuition-waiver places to top-ranked applicants, decided with the admission file rather than a separate scholarship form.

Programme Highlights

  • Single-portal applications to Estonian universities
  • Tuition-waiver places common for competitive applicants
  • Programme-specific deadlines inside the DreamApply system
  • English-taught degrees across IT, engineering and business fields

Who Should Apply

Bachelor's graduates targeting English-taught Estonian master's programmes; requirements vary by programme within the listing.

Funding and Costs

Estonian universities offer tuition-waiver places for strong applicants; scholarship conditions appear with each programme listing. Confirm the exact funding package on the official page before applying.

Deadline and How to Apply

Open the DreamApply listing, confirm the programme and its closing date, and complete the application inside the portal. Key deadline information: Application windows per the listed programme — check the DreamApply course page for its closing date.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About Study in Estonia

Study in Estonia is the national gateway to Estonian higher education, using the DreamApply platform for direct applications to English-taught programmes with tuition-waiver options.

Official website: https://estonia.dreamapply.com

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: Varies by programme - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
